content: Samar Ghosh inquired with insurance agent Ravi Menon about whether paying the $542.50 renewal fee would reinstate their expired policy, acknowledging a potential coverage lapse. Ravi confirmed policy reactivation upon payment and verified that the previously emailed payment link remains valid. Samar agreed to pay ASAP and requested an update once the payment is processed.
